candidates.title: Keep the horizontal scrollbar quiet during Down navigation?
criteria: Does Down scroll vertically without bringing up the horizontal scrollbar?
candidates.content: Launch the frozen build below. Select a source line around lines 500–600. Let any horizontal scrollbar fade, then tap or hold Down until the source view scrolls vertically. The horizontal scrollbar should stay faded during that vertical navigation. Horizontal panning or hovering its area should still show the native bar normally. Try split and unified views as part of this same scrollbar judgment. The row alignment and accepted touchpad axis behavior are retained. Accept to keep this scrollbar behavior, or Reject and describe the change in the note. Save, then use Finish and hand back.

metadata.protection_scope: Exact read-only frozen root/source/build. Shared main has unrelated concurrent focus_source edits, which cannot mutate these frozen bytes.
